activity.notes: Pedro I was acclaimed constitutional Emperor of Brazil on 12 October 1822 and abdicated the Brazilian throne on 7 April 1831. ATLAS records only his Brazilian imperial reign here; his brief 1826 reign in Portugal as Pedro IV is a distinct office and polity and is not merged into this Activity.

sources.title: Cetro de d. Pedro I e d. Pedro II — Museu Imperial
sources.citation_text: Museu Imperial identifies Pedro I as Brazil's first emperor, describes his acclamation and coronation in 1822, and records his 1831 abdication in favor of Pedro II.

sources.title: Dom Pedro de Alcantara: Primeiro Imperador do Brasil — Biblioteca Nacional Digital
sources.citation_text: Brazil's National Library identifies Pedro I as the first Emperor of Brazil and states that he abdicated on 7 April 1831; its collection classifies the First Reign as 1822-1831.
